subject: MSA & Order Form — third-party claim evidence window and escalation path
messages:
From: Emma Ruiz <emma.ruiz@greentech.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
Cc: Daniel Park <dpark@gc.greentech.com>
Date: Tue, 05 Jan 2027 10:22:00 -0800
Subject: MSA/Order Form - request: evidence window + escalation path

Marcus —

Thanks for the draft order form. Two items came up in our procurement/legal review that we need clarified before we can proceed to signature:

1) Evidence preservation window: we need assurance that, if GreenTech receives notice of a third-party IP claim tied to model output, Redwood will preserve logs, prompts, and any model artifacts for a minimum of 120 days (or longer if litigation is reasonably anticipated). The current redline shows a 30‑day preservation period which is too short for our compliance team.

2) Escalation & defense control: our general counsel is pushing for a clarified notice-and-escalation path that gives GreenTech the right to direct remediation if Redwood does not act within an agreed SLA (48 hours for triage, 7 days for remediation plan). We are open to discussing a narrowly tailored carveout for customer-specific training datasets, but we need clear evidence-handling steps in the MSA/Order Form.

Can your team propose contract language that: (a) extends the preservation window; (b) defines the escalation SLA; and (c) sets an evidence checklist for notices? Daniel (cc) will review any legal text.

Best,
Emma Ruiz
Head of Procurement, GreenTech Systems
emma.ruiz@greentech.com

Attachment: GreenTech-evidence-requirements.pdf (referenced)

From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
To: Emma Ruiz <emma.ruiz@greentech.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 05 Jan 2027 13:10:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: MSA/Order Form - request: evidence window + escalation path

Emma —

Thanks for the flags and the PDF. Appreciate the level of detail. Quick response from our side: we can be pragmatic here but need to balance scope and operational feasibility. Proposed commercial approach (high level):

- Preservation window: agree to preserve relevant artifacts for 90 days by default; we will extend preservation on a good‑faith written request tied to pending litigation (reasonable extension, reviewed by both parties).
- SLA / escalation: we can commit to 48h initial triage and 7 calendar days for a remediation plan for high‑severity third‑party IP notices, provided we can preserve our right to assume defense if defense control is asserted in accordance with the MSA.
- Evidence checklist: I'll have Legal draft a concise list we can both reference in the Order Form (logs, API request/response traces, redacted prompts where applicable, manifest of model version and weights/dev environment).

Kimberly — can you propose contract language that implements the above and keeps the defense-control mechanics (right to defend) intact? Ben — can you confirm whether we have any capacity/ops constraints for a 90‑day preservation SLA and what we would need to operationalize extended hold requests (storage, escrow triggers, evidence handoff owner)?

Emma / Daniel — I attached a draft redline that reflects the 90‑day preservation and proposed SLA timeline so you have a starting point. Open to a short call this week to walk through.

Thanks,
Marcus Lin
Head of Sales, Redwood Inference
marcus.lin@redwood.com

Attachments: OrderForm_v3_redline.docx

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
Cc: Emma Ruiz <emma.ruiz@greentech.com>, Daniel Park <dpark@gc.greentech.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 06 Jan 2027 09:05:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: MSA/Order Form - request: evidence window + escalation path

Marcus / Emma / Daniel —

Thanks — I reviewed Marcus' proposal and drafted language that attempts to thread the needle between GreenTech's preservation request and our operational constraints. Key points in the draft below (see attached redline for inline text):

- Evidence Preservation: Redwood will preserve the items listed in Exhibit A (logs, request/response traces, model id/manifest, redacted prompt/response artifacts where feasible) for a period of 90 days from notice. If litigation is reasonably anticipated and either party requests, the preservation period will be extended as reasonably necessary, provided the requesting party pays for extraordinary storage costs beyond normal retention.

- Escalation / SLA: Upon receipt of a Third‑Party Claim Notice, Redwood will (i) acknowledge receipt within 48 hours, (ii) complete initial triage within 48 hours, and (iii) provide a remediation plan within 7 calendar days for high‑severity notices. If Redwood elects to assume defense under the MSA, Redwood will notify Customer within 5 business days and coordinate counsel selection.

- Defense control: language preserves the parties' MSA right-to-defend allocation. To address Customer concern, we've added a defined escalation path if Redwood fails to meet triage/remediation SLAs: Customer may provide written direction for interim mitigation steps, limited to non‑destructive actions and subject to reimbursement for any incremental costs.

Requests / asks:
- Marcus / Ben: Ops needs an engineering owner to confirm we can capture the required artifacts for 90 days and the expected storage delta. I've attached an evidence checklist and asked for cost estimate input.
- Emma / Daniel: please review the attached Exhibit A checklist to confirm it meets GreenTech's audit needs or mark items that are required vs preferred.

If everyone is aligned, Legal can convert the text into a tracked redline for the MSA/order form. Happy to join a call.

Thanks,
Kimberly Park
Senior Counsel, Redwood Inference
kimberly.park@redwood.com

Attachments: OrderForm_v3_redline.docx, evidence-preservation-checklist.xlsx

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Emma Ruiz <emma.ruiz@greentech.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 08 Jan 2027 16:03:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: MSA/Order Form - request: evidence window + escalation path

Emma —

Appreciate the thoughtful asks and thanks to Kimberly and Marcus for the quick turnaround. Commercially, Redwood is prepared to accept the 90‑day standard preservation window and the SLA/escalation mechanics outlined in Kimberly's draft as part of Order Form execution for DT-4891, subject to two commercial guardrails: (1) a discrete per‑claim cap on extraordinary preservation costs (we'll share a short fee schedule if preservation exceeds our standard retention), and (2) a mutual commitment that Customer will notify Redwood promptly and provide reasonably detailed claim information to limit scope.

If GreenTech is comfortable with those guardrails, we can finalize language and proceed to signature. Proposed next steps:
- GreenTech to confirm Exhibit A checklist and whether you require the 120‑day preservation as a hard term or can accept our 90‑day + extension-by-request approach.
- Redwood Legal to issue tracked MSA/Order Form redline after receipt of GreenTech's Exhibit A feedback.
- Optional 30‑minute sync (Marcus / Kimberly / Emma / Daniel) to close open points — please propose availability.

Thanks — looking forward to wrapping this up.

Best regards,
Ben Carter
Director, Strategic Accounts, Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.com
